MOD = 1000000007

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.mat = [[0] * (size + 1) for _ in range(size + 1)]
        
    def __mul__(self, B):
        C = Matrix(self.size)
        for i in range(self.size + 1):
            for j in range(self.size + 1):
                val = 0
                for k in range(self.size + 1):
                    val += self.mat[i][k] * B.mat[k][j]
                C.mat[i][j] = val % MOD
        return C

def main():
    N, K = map(int, input().split())
    digits = []
    while N:
        digits.append(N % K)
        N //= K
    digits.reverse()
    count_digits = len(digits)

    # Initialize A, prefixSum, suffix matrices
    A = [[Matrix(K) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(count_digits)]
    prefixSum = [[Matrix(K) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(count_digits)]
    suffix = [[Matrix(K) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(count_digits)]

    # Build base matrices
    for i in range(K):
        for j in range(K):
            A[0][i].mat[j][j] = 1
            A[0][i].mat[j][i] = 1
        A[0][i].size = K

    # Compute prefixSum[0]
    prefixSum[0][0] = A[0][0]
    for i in range(1, K):
        prefixSum[0][i] = prefixSum[0][i - 1] * A[0][i]

    # Compute suffix[0]
    suffix[0][K - 1] = A[0][K - 1]
    for i in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
        suffix[0][i] = A[0][i] * suffix[0][i + 1]

    # Build matrices for subsequent digits
    for i in range(1, count_digits):
        A[i][0] = suffix[i - 1][0]
        for j in range(1, K):
            A[i][j] = suffix[i - 1][j] * prefixSum[i - 1][j - 1]
        # Compute prefixSum[i]
        prefixSum[i][0] = A[i][0]
        for j in range(1, K):
            prefixSum[i][j] = prefixSum[i][j - 1] * A[i][j]
        # Compute suffix[i]
        suffix[i][K - 1] = A[i][K - 1]
        for j in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
            suffix[i][j] = A[i][j] * suffix[i][j + 1]

    # Initialize result matrix
    result = Matrix(K)
    result.mat[0][K] = 1
    result.size = K

    # Multiply result by prefixSum for last digit
    result = result * prefixSum[count_digits - 1][digits[-1] - 1]

    last = digits[-1]
    for i in range(count_digits - 2, -1, -1):
        for j in range(digits[i]):
            result = result * A[i][(j + last) % K]
        last += digits[i]

    total = 0
    for i in range(K + 1):
        total += result.mat[0][i]
    print(total % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
